title: How a Premier League Legend Transformed Como Into a European Giant

From Premier League Star to Serie A Manager
hook: How a Premier League legend conquered Italy.

scenes.text: How a Premier League legend conquered Italy.
Cesc Fàbregas carved open defenses for Arsenal and Barcelona for years.
Then in 2022, he shocked the football world by joining Italian club Como.
He started as a player and bought a stake in the club.
Soon, he hung up his boots and took charge from the touchline.
His legendary vision translated instantly into brilliant tactics on the pitch.
In the 2025-26 season, Como stunned Italy by finishing fourth in Serie A.
Securing a historic spot in the UEFA Champions League tournament.
